user.title: Choose a DeepL account
user.description: Selected phrases will be translated through this configured account.

abort.deepl_required: Set up [DeepL Translator](https://github.com/seb5594/hass-deepl_translator-integration) first, then try again.

preferences.title: Language and sidebar
preferences.description: Choose “system” to follow the Home Assistant system language.

data_description.scan_interval_hours: Default 24 hours. Set to 0 to disable the periodic check. Checks after installations and at startup stay enabled.

deactivate.title: Disable the translator?
deactivate.description: By default all translations are kept. Select the option to first restore originals and remove files created solely by the translator. {detail}

abort.provider_unavailable: The configured DeepL account is unavailable.

error.restore_failed: Cleanup stopped. Review the affected file in the workspace.

open_workspace.name: Open translations
open_workspace.description: Open the workspace in the calling administrator’s visible browser. Automations without a user context create a notification with a link.

missing.title: {name} · {count} missing phrases ({language})
missing.description: The existing translation is missing source phrases. [Review and add phrases]({url})

retained.title: Review retained translations
retained.description: The translator was disabled or removed. {count} managed language files were kept. Confirm that choice or undo the changes.

review.title: Keep translations?
review.description: Leave the box unchecked to keep the files. Undoing changes restores originals and removes generated files. {detail}
